title: Dawnice Deploys 668kWh Energy Storage System at Irish Mushroom Factory
summary: A 668kWh solar-powered storage system installed and commissioned at a mushroom factory in Ireland.
challenge: Mushroom cultivation runs climate control, lighting and automated handling around the clock. A grid interruption or a price spike hits the crop directly, and rising electricity costs were pressing on the operating margin.
solution: A 668kWh solar-plus-storage system, installed and commissioned on site, sized against the factory's continuous load.
result: The system carries the factory's continuous demand and supports round-the-clock operation on solar.
